major_cooldowns.name: Spirit Link Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it to split an overwhelming hit on one player across the group, or to level everyone to the same health percentage just before a raid-wide hit; it also gives 10% damage reduction inside its 10 yard radius, 15% with Spouting Spirits, plus a large burst heal one second after it lands.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 98008 is the cast id; 325174 is the aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Healing Tide Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Totemic raid cooldown on a choice node with Ascendance: instant and free to move or keep casting afterwards, it pulses every 2 seconds and reaches full output with at least 5 allies inside 40 yards, so drop it into stacked raid damage rather than spot pressure.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Farseer raid cooldown on a choice node with Healing Tide Totem: enter it with targets already damaged so the window pays off, then spam Chain Heal for 3 extra jumps at only 10% loss per jump and Healing Wave for guaranteed crits plus a second ally at 50%; react instantly to free Deeply Rooted Elements procs.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114052 is the Restoration (Water Ascendant) cast id; 114050/114051/1219480 are the Elemental and Enhancement versions.

major_cooldowns.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it for periods of heavy movement where throughput matters, or to reposition without dropping a cast; it is castable while casting, so it never costs a global.

major_cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown for the free Stormstream Totem proc and spend the instant, mana-free cast on Chain Heal.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 378081 is the Shaman cast and aura id; 132158 is the Druid spell of the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Ancestral Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Farseer upgrade that replaces Nature's Swiftness at half the cooldown: press it on cooldown to spawn an Ancestor, proc Stormstream Totem, and make the next spell instant, free, and 10% stronger.

major_cooldowns.name: Healing Stream Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it for emergency healing and whenever you are at maximum charges so none are wasted, and keep it rolling under Ascendance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 5394 is the cast id; 52042 is the healing event.

major_cooldowns.name: Stormstream Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The apex payoff, procced by Riptide and by Nature's Swiftness or Ancestral Swiftness: it does not consume regular Healing Stream Totem charges once fully unlocked, so hold it for a real damage window but spend it before both Healing Stream Totem charges come back up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1267068 is the cast id; 1267089 is the proc aura and 1267016 the talent node.

major_cooldowns.name: Bloodlust
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Give the raid 30% haste for 40 seconds, normally at the pull while everyone still has their own cooldowns, unless the encounter plan calls for a later burn window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Horde faction spell; Alliance shaman cast Heroism (32182).

major_cooldowns.name: Heroism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Alliance version of the same 30% haste buff: cast it at the pull alongside the raid's damage cooldowns unless the encounter plan calls for a later burn window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Alliance faction spell; Horde shaman cast Bloodlust (2825).

rule.description: Spend Unleash Life on Chain Heal or Healing Wave
rule.action: Cast Unleash Life on an injured ally on cooldown for its direct heal, then spend the follow-up buff straight away on Chain Heal or Healing Wave, which also gain the reduced cast time; Riptide is already instant and gains the least.

rule.description: Spend Stormstream Totem procs before HST recharges
rule.action: The proc lasts 60 seconds and stacks twice, so hold it for a real damage window, but spend it before both Healing Stream Totem charges are ready or you lose a totem cast.

rule.description: Spend Nature's Swiftness on Chain Heal
rule.action: Press Nature's Swiftness on cooldown for the Stormstream Totem proc and put the free instant cast into Chain Heal, or Healing Wave when a single player is the problem; never let the buff expire unused.
